name: Mr. Dufrain
tagline: Keeps the household books and warns you before a payment lands
description: An accountant for one person rather than a company. It follows what comes in against what goes out, keeps the tax position in view, and raises a flag while there is still time to move something before a due date arrives. Payday is treated as the moment to chip away at debt, so more of the cheque survives the month.
author: Wagmoo
